description: [GA4 WRITE] Change a user's roles on an account (needs analytics.manage.users). The roles you pass replace the binding's roles. This API has no updateMask: the supplied fields replace the whole resource. Requires GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

name.description: Full resource name of the account access binding to target, e.g. "properties/123/…/456".

name: ga4_update_account_access_binding
